services.1.long: Landing page kata profile mar kompani konyo biashara chiwo nyalo maber mokwongo. Wanyiso kit mar ukur, weche kod neno mondo jowuoth ng'e piyo gima ichiwo kendo gombo wuo kodi.

process.0.long: Kapok wachako gero gimoro, wadwaro ngʼeyo biashara mari: gima ichomo, jowuoth kaka, kod gik ma ochuno ahinya. Ka wasetiyo kuom mano, wanyiso weche ma ochuno mondo tich mondo kik bed ma ok nyal kendo pesa kik ter.

process.0.result: Orodhi mar gik ma dwarore kod ma ochuno ma wasepogore.
process.1.long: Wabiro loso kit mar ukur kod ranyisi mar neno mokwongo. Inyalo ngʼiyo kendo chiwo paro kapok gero ochak, mondo gima ogik bed machiegni gi gima ipar.
process.1.do.0: Chenro kit mar ukur kod yo wuoth

process.1.result: Nonro ma wasepogore kapok tich chak.
process.2.long: Ka nonro oseyie, websayt, app kata tich ma dhi kende ogero. Nenore maber e simu kod kompyuta, kendo inyalo chiwo paro kinde tich dhi nyime.
process.2.do.0: Gero ukurni kod tije kaluwore gi nonro
process.2.do.1: Nono ni nenore maber e simu, tablet kod kompyuta
process.2.do.2: Seto gik ma ochuno mondo ji yud yo ma yot e Google
process.2.do.3: Nyiso kaka tich dhi nyime kinde ka kinde
process.2.you: Loso weche, picha kod logo, kendo chiw paro ka nigi.
process.2.result: Chenro mokwongo ma inyalo temo. Websayt matin kinde mangʼeny orumo e ndalo 1–3 mag tich ka gik moko oseikore.
process.3.long: Watemo gima oyudore kaachiel. Gimoro amora ma ok ber ogere, eka gik moko duto otemi kendo nyaka oriwore maber e kit simu duto kendo oikore chako tiyo.
process.3.do.0: Ngʼiyo nenore e wich simu ma tinde ma duongʼ
process.3.do.3: Rito ni gik moko duto oikore chako tiyo
process.3.you: Tem gima oyudore kendo nyisowa gima idwaro mondo ologi.
process.4.long: Gima ogero oketi e intanet kendo odinore ne ji duto. Waseto mondo yud yo e Google, eka wachiwi yo donjo kaachiel gi puonj mar tiyo kode mondo ichung kode maber.
process.4.do.0: Keto websayt kata app e intanet
process.4.do.1: Loso metadata kod SEO mar chakruok
process.4.do.2: Chiwo yo donjo kod puonj mar tiyo
process.4.do.3: Konyoni gi higa 1 mar konyruok maonge chudo, kod domain (Small package) kata hosting (Large package)
process.4.you: Rit yo donjo mari maber kendo chak nyiso jong'iew mari.
process.4.result: Websayt kata app nitie e intanet kendo oikore tiyo kode.

faq.title: Penjo ma ji penjo kinde mangʼeny kapok chako.
faq.description: Ka penjo mari pok ni kae, wuoyo mar puonj nyalo konyi ngʼeyo gima idwaro.
faq.0.question: Nocoding nyalo loso tije mage?
faq.0.answer: Wagero websayt mar portfolio kata CV mar dhano, landing page kata profile mar kompani, yor weche kod tich, kod tich ma dhi kende mar biashara.
faq.1.question: Gero kawo kinde marom nade?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV kata landing page matin kinde mangʼeny kawo ndalo 1-3 mag tich bangʼ ka gik moko oseikore. Tije madongo luwo gima dwarore, kethore kod kaka ichiwo paro.
faq.2.question: Nonro kod tije nyalo loko?
faq.2.answer: Ee. Nonro, kit mar ukur, tije kod yo tich nyalo loko kaluwore gi gima idwaro. Nonro ongʼiyi kaachiel kapok gero ochak.
faq.3.question: Nengo ketho gige mage?
faq.3.answer: Nengo ketho gero kaluwore gi package kod gima wasepogore. Small package nigi konyruok maonge chudo kod domain higa 1, to Big package nigi konyruok maonge chudo kod hosting higa 1.
contact.title: Nyisowa gima websayt mari dwaro. Wakonyi mondo yo bed ler.
contact.description: Ol weche matin mar biashara mari, ukurni ma idwaro, kod kinde ma idwaro. Dwoko mokwongo biro gi paro mar gima dwarore kod weche modok. Wuoyo mar puonj ok chudi saa asaya ma idwaro.

project.category.ecoswap: Websayt mar chiemo gik ma osetiyo
project.description.ecoswap: Chiro e intanet mar ngʼiewo kod uso gik ma osetiyo. Ji nyalo keto, ngʼiyo kod ngʼiewo mayot gi simu kata kompyuta.
project.description.wiboost: Duka e intanet mar tije mag dijitol kaka keto pesa e mikayi, pakej mag data kod app mag premium, gi pesa mar jong'iew kod chenro mar jouso.
project.description.ahawi: Websayt mar portfolio mar dhano e kit picha mar pende mar pi, gi dho ariyo, mondo nyis ngima, rieko kod yo wuoyo.
project.description.abdi: Yor ndiko mar jotich mag od ruoth (abdi dalem) mar Keraton Surakarta: ndiko nyingi, data mar dhano, kinde mar tije, bedo kuno kod loso kar ID.
project.description.sfarm: App mar rito puodho mar gweno kod diek mar gwengʼ: ndiko mar odiechieng, uso, kwath pesa kod ripot mar pesa.
project.description.payu: Kar ma riwo jogo ma keto tije gi jotich mag giechgi. Jogo ma keto tije chiwo chudo, jotich gologo tich, kendo chudo timore gi QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Katalogi e intanet ma nigi gik mogwaro alufu achiel. Jong'iew nyalo yenyo, yiero kendo kwayo piyo e WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Duka e intanet mar app mag premium
project.description.ianprem: Duka e intanet mar akaunt mag app mag premium kaka Netflix kod Spotify. Jong'iew yiero kendo chudo giwegi, to jotich mag admin rito gik kod uso.
project.category.alengka: Websayt mar katalogi mar gik mag od
project.description.alengka: Katalogi e intanet mar gik mag od mar iye kod oko ne kafe, mochiemo kod ot. Jowuoth nyalo ngʼiyo gik ma nitie kendo wuoyo e WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Websayt mar skul mar primari ma nigi profile mar skul, weche mar donjo mar nyithindo manyien, orodhi mar jopuonj, tije moko kod gima nyithindo oyudo.
project.category.furnix: Websayt mar katalogi mar gik mag od
project.description.furnix: Katalogi e intanet mar gik mag od mar nyinyo moa Jepara ne kafe, mochiemo kod ot. Jowuoth nyalo yiero gik kendo kwayo kaluwore gi dwaroni.
project.description.clothique: Duka e intanet mar lope mochop: katalogi, kikapu mar ngʼiewo, chudo e intanet, blog kod kar admin mar rito kwayo kod ripot.
project.description.agli: Gima konyo oganda mag ndiko mondo oket kaachiel ranyisi mag ndiko ma ji ngʼiyo ahinya, ongʼe kit mag timo, kendo oloso ndiko manyien.
project.description.nebulist: Gima konyo e uso ma tiyo gi AI ma loso chenro, ndiko mag jong'iew manyalo biro kod ndiko mag wach mar ketho ma moa kuom weche mar gima iuso.
project.description.carbonfi: App mar pesa mar dijitol mar uso carbon credit (pok ne matimo mondo yawo yamo kuyo) kod chenro mag pok mag rito piny.

project.description.pedulichain: Kar chiwo ma ler: chiwo moro ka moro kod kaka pesa otiyo ondiki ma ok pudhi kendo ji duto nyalo neno.
project.description.astra: Jakony mar AI ma inyalo wuoyo kode mana kamano mondo irit gik mag dijitol, kaka ol token kata loso gik mag dijitol ma ok chal gi moko, ma ok idwar ngʼeyo coding.
project.description.auditfi: Gima ngʼiyo kwe mar AI ne yor pesa mar dijitol ma yudo kuonde ma ok tek kendo ondiko ripot e sekonde.
project.category.p2p: App mar lokruok mag gik mag dijitol
project.description.p2p: Kar mar lokruok mag gik mag dijitol e kind ji, gi kwe mar chudo kod kar admin mar rito kar.
project.description.payguppy: App ma konyo duka matindo yudo chudo mar pesa mar dijitol gi kode mag QR ma gin kod gi.
project.category.tiptap: App mar jogo ma loso ndiko
project.description.tiptap: Kar ne jogo ma loso ndiko mondo oyud pok moa kuom jongʼiyo e pesa mar dijitol kata gik mag dijitol ma ok chal gi moko, gi wach mar ketho e kinde mar live.
project.description.senkus: Tugo e intanet ma nigi wach mar sayans kod alkemi: jotugo riwo yath, kano gik mag dijitol kendo tekore e kar tugo.
project.category.quickstock: App mar rito gik mag uso
project.description.quickstock: App mar kompyuta mar rito gik mag duka mar lope: ndiko uso, kelo gik moa kuom jolosogi kod ripot mar gik, gi yo donjo ma luwo tich mar jotich moro ka moro.
project.description.caer: Kar mar nego kod ng'iewo gik mag dijitol e kind network ka ochiko IDRX rupia mar dijitol, mondo mayot kano kod nego.
